subtitleNullable: The largest public dataset of 90 000+ games published on Steam.
descriptionNullable:
This dataset has been created with Steam store page scraping and [**Steam Games Scraper**](https://github.com/FronkonGames/Steam-Games-Scraper) repository, which gathers data using the Steam API and Steam Spy.

This dataset is up to date as of March 2025, and contains two data versions - raw parsed dataset (games_march2025_full.csv), as well as a cleaned version without duplicate & playtest versions of games (games_march2025_cleaned.csv).
